findings.check: a large move is explained by a corporate action
findings.detail: moves of at least 40.0% day-over-day; a corporate action on the same ISIN within 3 days counts as explained. 566 explained, 1667 not. An unexplained jump of this size is where momentum goes wrong.

gap_note: Gaps are listed, not failed. NSE holidays are not derivable from this table, so a holiday and a hole look identical here and a human has to tell them apart.
